settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Targets under-eye puffiness and facial fluid retention.
  • Supports lymphatic drainage and improved circulation.
  • Enhances muscle tone and definition with multi-wavelength microcurrent.
  • Boosts hydration and product absorption for clearer, rested skin.

settings.title: What's Included?
settings.content:
• MyoLift™ Triwave device
  • ReStore Conductive Gel (4 oz)
  • Eye Lift Serum
  • Conductive Gloves (pair)
  • Infused Solution (2 oz)
  • RePlenish Spritzer (2 oz)
  • Eye Mask (hands-free conductive)
  • Silicone Brush
  • Headband
  • Luxury 7E Carry Bag

settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
1. Cleanse the skin thoroughly.
  2. Apply ReStore gel to treatment areas with the silicone brush.
  3. Place the hands-free eye mask under the eye and connect to the Triwave.
  4. Run a combined Erase and Educate program (total 10–30 minutes per protocol).
  5. Optionally use conductive gloves on the cheeks or jaw during or after mask time.
  6. Remove masks, wipe excess gel, and finish with Eye Lift Serum and a light mist of RePlenish.

settings.title: Who is this for?
settings.content:
• New buyers who want a device plus a targeted depuffing kit.

• Anyone wanting visible under-eye decongestion and improved facial contour

• Gift buyers seeking a device kit for someone who wants spa-level at-home care.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
Experience Advanced Beauty Technology with 7E Wellness

Dual Wavelength Technology: Target specific muscle groups with precision using two customizable wavelengths tailored to your treatment needs.

Smart App Integration: Unlock the power of technology with our app. Access preset treatments, design custom routines, and schedule one-on-one consultations for expert guidance.

AI Skin Analysis: Monitor your skin’s health and track progress before and after treatments. Let the app analyze your skin to help you achieve optimal results.

Personalized Treatment Plans: Based on AI skin analysis and your specific concerns, our Smart App creates a treatment plan just for you. Seamlessly progress through beginner, intermediate, and advanced levels while keeping track of your journey.

Ergonomic Design: Lightweight, travel-friendly, and easy to use, making your beauty routine effortless wherever you go.

Hands-Free Masks: Indulge in a spa-like experience at home with convenient, hands-free masks for a luxurious treatment.

Conductive Gel: Enhance your microcurrent therapy results with a nourishing gel designed to hydrate and revitalize your skin.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: What makes the Triwave Detox & Depuff Kit different from other kits?
settings.text1: This kit pairs the Triwave device’s multi-wavelength microcurrent with targeted depuffing treatments, specifically designed to reduce under-eye puffiness, facial fluid retention, and sluggish tone, giving you spa-quality results at home.
settings.title2: How often should I use the Triwave Detox & Depuff Kit?
settings.text2: For best results, use 2–3 times per week on the under-eye and facial contour areas. Follow the included Erase and Educate protocols for 10–30 minutes.
settings.title3: Can I use the conductive gloves with the eye mask?
settings.text3: Yes! You can wear the conductive gloves on your cheeks or jaw during or after using the hands-free eye mask to enhance contouring and lift.
settings.title4: Is this kit suitable for first-time microcurrent users?
settings.text4: Absolutely. It’s perfect for anyone new to microcurrent who wants visible depuffing and improved facial tone, with step-by-step instructions included.
settings.title5: Can I travel with this kit?
settings.text5: Yes. The kit comes with a luxury 7E carry bag that fits the Triwave device, masks, gels, and accessories for easy portability.
settings.title6: How long before I see results?
settings.text6: Many users notice reduced puffiness and refreshed skin after the first session, with consistent improvements in tone and contour over 4–6 weeks.
